selection_policy: quality/stability gate first; all requested levels require decision-grade fixture/run observations; direct-unit timing is required only for otherwise quality-stable levels; rank eligible levels by end-to-end command_duration_ms, then direct_unit_duration_ms, then effort order

winner.rationale: Selected the fastest end-to-end command duration among decision-grade levels with complete runs, semantic pass rate 1.0, stage semantic pass rate 1.0, and complete direct unit timing observations; direct unit duration is used as the first tie-breaker.
